d4.rule: On pin2015 (and reported on the newest I_INDEPENDENT board): build A' = release defaults (dlf_values_rank_hill_vote OFF, DLF IDP held) and B' = the same with dlf_values_rank_hill_vote ON, incumbent filter. The D4 regression set is every (offense row, source) pair dropped by the incumbent in B' and not in A', excluding DLF Values' own vote. Membership is computed by this rule at Stage 3 and committed before the V_HELDOUT run; it is not edited afterwards.
